output.title: New opt-in ingress-shim flag for copying annotations
output.content: The change adds the ingress-shim option `--extra-certificate-annotations` to copy listed annotation keys from Ingress-like resources to the resulting Certificate. It is a new option rather than a changed default. The environment's manifests show only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate, with no Ingress-like resources, and none of the values keys set relate to it.
